meta.name: imagemagick
meta.description: Use this skill whenever scientific image assets need deterministic preprocessing (resize, crop, convert, DPI normalization, montage/contact sheets) using ImageMagick 7 `magick`.

copy.tagline: 用 ImageMagick 批量预处理科研图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要批量调整图片尺寸、格式或分辨率。
copy.tagline_en: Batch preprocess scientific images with ImageMagick
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to resize, convert, or normalize images in bulk.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能用 ImageMagick 7 对科学图片进行可重复的预处理，如调整大小、裁剪、格式转换、设置 DPI、去除白边、生成联系表等。
howto.when: 当你需要处理科学图片，如调整尺寸、转换格式、设置 DPI 或生成联系表时触发。

say.text: 把这张图缩放到宽度 1600 像素，保持比例。
say.note: Claude 会执行 magick resize 命令。

say.text: 把这张 TIFF 转成高质量 JPEG。
把当前文件夹的 PNG 图做成联系表。
say.note: Claude 会生成 montage 联系表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ImageMagick 7 for reproducible preprocessing of scientific images, such as resizing, cropping, format conversion, DPI normalization, trimming whitespace, and generating contact sheets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process scientific images, e.g., resize, convert format, set DPI, or create contact sheets.

say_en.text: Resize this image to 1600 pixels wide, keeping aspect ratio.
say_en.note: Claude will run magick resize command.

say_en.text: Convert this TIFF to high-quality JPEG.
Make a contact sheet from PNGs in this folder.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a montage contact sheet.
